title: Mastering Business Central API for App Management
summary: This post provides practical PowerShell examples for automating extension management in Business Central using the Administration API, including deploying .app files, monitoring installation progress, handling failures, and uninstalling extensions.
key_points: Authenticate with the Business Central Administration API using client credentials to obtain an access token for multipart requests
Deploy extensions using the pteInstall endpoint with specific parameters like deploymentSchedule, syncMode, languageId, and EULA acceptance
Poll the operations endpoint after deployment to monitor installation status and detect succeeded, failed, or canceled operations
Uninstall extensions by checking dependencies first, then calling the uninstall endpoint with parameters for update window, dependents, and data deletion

quotes.text: To uninstall an extension, we first check whether any dependencies must be removed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Checking dependencies before uninstall prevents errors and ensures safe removal of extensions
